entities.summary: Nabeshima Naohiro or Nabeshima Chokudai  was the 11th and final daimyō of Saga Domain in Hizen Province, Kyūshū, Japan. Before the Meiji Restoration, his name was Nabeshima Mochizane  and his honorary title was Hizen-no-Kami.
